sources.title: GitHub - Tencent-Hunyuan/AuK: AuK: An Open-Source Foundational Model ...
sources.snippet: AuK is a 1.5B foundation model for speech generation and editing. Trained on millions of hours of diverse audio data, AuK supports zero-shot and instruction-based TTS, content and acoustic editing, paralinguistic editing, speech enhancement, and source separation through a unified natural-language instruction interface.
